walkthroughs.body_html:
Globalisation = the world becoming more connected through trade, travel and tech.

Cheap shipping and the internet pushed it forward.

An iPhone has parts from many countries:

  • Designed in California.
  • Glass from Japan.
  • Chips from Taiwan.
  • Assembled in China.

This global supply chain makes the iPhone cheaper. 🌍

Multinationals like Coca-Cola, Toyota and Nike operate in dozens of countries.

Trade blocs like the EU let members trade without tariffs.

The WTO sets rules so trade is fair.

mcqs.q: What is the difference between monetary and fiscal policy?
options: Ceteris paribus is a Latin name for the equilibrium price.
Monetary policy is about money and fiscal policy is about taxes.
Monetary policy uses interest rates and money supply controlled by the central bank; fiscal policy uses government taxation and spending controlled by the Treasury.
Both terms mean the same thing — government economic policy.

mcqs.q: What is the predicted effect of a binding price ceiling like rent control?
options: Shortage in the market — quantity demanded exceeds quantity supplied at the controlled price, leading to queues, black markets and reduced quality.
Price ceilings make goods cheaper for everyone with no downsides.
Both terms mean the same thing — government economic policy.
Price ceilings only affect the rich.

mcqs.q: What does the assumption 'ceteris paribus' mean in economic models?
options: Both terms mean the same thing — government economic policy.
Ceteris paribus is a Latin name for the equilibrium price.
'All other things equal' — when analysing the effect of one variable, all other variables are held constant. It is an analytical simplification, not a claim about reality.
Ceteris paribus means everything happens at the same time in real markets.
